recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio photograph featuring two vintage ceramic figurines—a girl and a boy—leaning toward each other as if to kiss. The scene is set against a stark white background with a soft, diffused reflection on a polished surface, paired with gritty, typewriter-style lowercase typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Figurines positioned on the right third, facing left
Text blocks anchored to the left and bottom-center
Soft, cool-toned shadows contrasting with warm ceramic glazes
High-contrast typewriter ink against a clean, blown-out background
coreInvariants: Ceramic texture with visible glaze sheen

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figurines occupy the right half of the frame, scaled to approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point of near-contact between the two figurines' faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves right to the figurines, then follows the reflection down to the bottom-center text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space on the left side and top, creating a clean, airy atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background and negative space.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the typewriter ink and figurine details.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red and cream glazes on the ceramic figures.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) with low to moderate saturation in the subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to white, black, red, and cream

letterConstructionRules: Irregular ink bleed and mechanical distress
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' with a distinct square tittle

treatment.distortion: Slight vertical misalignment typical of typewriters

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the authentic distressed typewriter look perfectly.
A cleaner alternative for the bottom metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Photograph two vintage ceramic figurines (boy and girl) in a kiss-like pose on a reflective white surface. Use high-key lighting to blow out the background to pure white. Ensure soft shadows and a gentle reflection below the figures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply lowercase typewriter text in black. The main title should be stacked on the left with a distressed ink-bleed effect. The secondary text should be centered at the bottom with wider tracking and a cleaner typewriter finish.

verificationChecks: Do the figurines have a visible ceramic glaze texture?
Is the reflection soft and diffused?

adjustableVariables: Amount of negative space on the left
Color of the figurine accents (e.g., blue instead of red)
mustRedesign: Do not use specific brand logos
Do not use the exact faces of trademarked characters
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white background is not grey or muddy
Verify the reflection matches the figurine silhouettes
Confirm the 'stacked' layout of the primary text
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Object + High-Key Studio Lighting + Distressed Typewriter Typography + Lowercase Styling
